model_decision.decision: Quantile extension did not meet frozen spatial-recovery/predictive criteria. End prior-repair series. Use original PM-calibrated lognormal joint density/velocity model with 24 nuisances and no added tracer curvature for one actual-data model-stress diagnosis.
model_decision.interpretation: Baseline is not scientifically promoted or certified. Its approximate field prior, galaxy link/selection and conditional noise model may be biased. A converged real-data fit is still provisional.

data.CF4: Retain actual BGc-transformed vobs, original positions/design/variance/holdout. Existing fixed args, cz1500-18000 km/s; this is not a direct LG catalog.
data.counts_contract: Use actual integer counts_train and counts_holdout with raw selection exposure and original six populations. Counts_all only verifies split consistency. Never centre priors or rescale exposure using observed totals.
data.limitations: Count hash split is a predictive partition, not an exact independent-Poisson experiment. Same-object exclusion does not eliminate every selection/systematic dependence; external density/bias priors may not match this restricted sample.
